title: Cracked the Code: 6 Years of Backtesting & Real Trading—Consistent 6.5–8% Monthly Option Selling Algo
author: Certain_Pipe1889
selftext:
​

(1) After five months of refining my approach, I finally cracked a parameter formula that works across all market conditions without tweaking settings for different years. Moving to a simplified option selling algo bumped my live monthly returns to 6.5–8% before compounding (net of real-world slippage and brokerage). Over a full 6-year backtest from August 2020 to date, the max drawdown was capped at just 11% of total capital.

(2) Here is the key to why this works: It’s built purely on asymmetrical risk-reward, not a high win rate. The strategy actually runs on a 37% win rate, meaning you will experience more red days than green ones. However, the average winning trade is 1.7x the size of an average loss. When you pair a massive 1:1.7 risk-reward profile with the natural decay edge of option selling, the math delivers exceptional consistency over time.

(3) 100% Fully Automated Architecture

I’m not from an engineering background, so building this took two months of prompt engineering with cloud AI to get the code near-perfect (with huge help from my dad in getting it across the finish line). It is hosted on an AWS Mumbai server for ultra-low latency execution. The setup is completely hands-off:

 \* Zero manual intervention: The bot automatically boots up every trading day at 8:45 AM, manages entries/exits, and shuts down on its own.

 \* Built-in holiday handling: Market holidays, weekends, and festival closures are pre-coded so it automatically skips non-trading days (as you can see in the execution screenshots).

Next Steps & Community Updates

To protect the hard work that went into cracking this formula, I am not selling or sharing the source code/strategy itself.

(4) However, to build trust, if this thread gets enough demand and traction, I will launch a Telegram channel where I’ll post my daily live P&L performance and automated trade log messages.

\> Important Note: This is strictly for performance tracking and transparency—I will not be giving live trade signals or tips, so please don't join expecting trade calls. 

If there is enough interest and everything continues to run smoothly, I may eventually build an execution infrastructure to offer access to the algo down the line.
